points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Exact 17724cd clean CMake build passed in restricted cfd-bench; current metadata names init-only 26ef1cb, so producing source is unbound.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve, case/output and restart; Output.cpp:285–328 writes/reads current and old states with step/time. Exact restart continuation not rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: solver/src separates CGNS reader, mesh construction, partition, numerics, solver and output; solver/tools supplies plotting and tests.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Inspected source/build and found no internal existing CFD solver invocation; no external authorship search performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp reads case configuration and configured CGNS mesh; no two-filename-only case branch established.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:62–74 partitions on root and distributes; Solver.cpp:439 uses same send/recv pointer in MPI_Allreduce without MPI_IN_PLACE, a runtime compatibility defect.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Final Solver.cpp:439 same-buffer MPI_Allreduce lacks MPI_IN_PLACE; current short laminar results have unstable force tails and Re200 no shedding. Source binding is unproved.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Curated solver/tests includes unit and probe sources; clean build includes nsc2d_tests. No new solver or unsteady case rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Submitted plot tool reproducibly misassigns quad cell values in final report image; current result metadata names init-only revision and report contains another run generation.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
